text:
Priority: urgent
When a check refuses a reading (for example the governance-files check, the previous-result check, or the producer-report criteria check), the next read does not see why: drain re-reads the same request cold, the reader makes the same omission, and the item fails twice and stops the drain. On 2026-10-28 a request mentioning CI was refused for leaving out .github/workflows/, and the second read failed the same way. Fix: when a reading is refused by a check, read again once at once with the refusal text given to the reader as a correction (the same path as athena correct), and record both readings; only a second refusal counts as a failure. Also list every reading check's rule in the reader's brief, in one short line each, so the first read can satisfy them.
Acceptance:
- A test with a fake reader whose first reading omits a governance file shows the refusal text reaches the second read and the second reading is accepted.
- A test shows two refusals in a row count as one failed item, not two separate drain failures.
- The reader brief names each reading check in one line and stays within its budget; the budgets test passes.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Files: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, CHANGELOG.md
